¿Buscas un proyecto dulce, frutal y repleto de la calidez más irresistible? 🫐🍌🥣 Crea a esta hermosa Niñita del Bowl de Açaí y Arándanos (Açaí Bowl Girl with Blueberries & Bananas) luciendo su gorrito acanalado en espiral en tono morado/açaí con detalle de arándanos y hojas en el lateral, melena corta con flequillo morado, vestido de gala con delantal bordado de frutas, zapatitos morados con calcetas dobles, sosteniendo un tazón lleno de crema de açaí, rodajas de plátano y frutos rojos, y enamórate de cada detalle hecho a mano.

PATRÓN PROFESIONAL NIÑITA DEL BOWL DE AÇAÍ AMIGURUMI / AÇAÍ BOWL GIRL PATTERN

Detalles del proyecto:

Tamaño final: 22–24 cm de alto aprox.

Nivel: Intermedio – Avanzado

Materiales principales:

Hilo de algodón Sport/DK (Tono piel clara/sonrojada, Morado intenso/Açaí para el gorro, melena y vestido, Blanco marfil/crema para el delantal, bordes y calcetas, Azul arándano/mora y Verde hoja para los detalles de frutas, Amarillo crema para las rodajas de plátano, Marrón/Café para el cuenco de mimbre)

Ganchillos de 2.5 mm y 2.0 mm

Ojos de seguridad negros de 10 mm

Relleno sintético (poliéster), aguja lanera y tijeras

Rubor rosado acentuado para las mejillas y pecas en marrón claro

ABREVIATURAS (ES):
AM = Anillo Mágico | pb = Punto Bajo | aum = Aumento | dism = Disminución
cad = Cadena | pr = Punto Raso | mpa = Medio Punto Alto | pa = Punto Alto
BLO = Hebra Trasera | FLO = Hebra Delantera | [ ] = Puntos totales

PASO A PASO COMPLETO:
1. ZAPATITOS MORADOS, CALCETAS Y VESTIDO DE AÇAÍ (Ganchillo 2.5 mm)
Zapatitos con Arándanos y Piernas (Haz 2):

En Morado Intenso: V1: 6 pb en AM [6] -> V2: 6 aum [12] -> V3–V5: 12 pb -> V6: 3 pb, 3 dism, 3 pb [9] (zapatos redondeados con arándano y hojita bordada en la punta).

Cambiar a Blanco Crema (Calcetas dobladas): En BLO V7–V11: 9 pb [9] con borde festoneado.

Cambiar a Piel Clara: En BLO V12–V20: 9 pb [9]. Rellenar firme y unir piernas con 3 cad.

Torso, Vestido Morado y Delantal Bordado:

Vestido: V21–V28: 24 pb en Morado Intenso con manguitas abullonadas en FLO.

Delantal Festoneado (Blanco Crema): Enganchar Blanco Crema en FLO de la cintura:

Tejer delantal acanalado en FLO con dobladillo en conchas festoneadas (1 pr, 3 mpa en un pto, 1 pr). Bordar ramilletes de arándanos morados con hojitas verdes intercaladas por todo el delantal.

Brazos y Manos (Haz 2):

En Piel Clara (Manitas): AM 6 pb -> V2–V4: 6 pb -> V5–V14: 8 pb con puños abullonados en Morado. Coser ambas manos sosteniendo el bowl de açaí contra el pecho.

--

2. CABEZA, FLEQUILLO MORADO Y GORRO EN ESPIRAL (Ganchillo 2.5 mm)
Cabeza (Color Piel Clara):

V1: 6 pb en AM [6] -> V2: 6 aum [12] -> V3: (1 pb, 1 aum) x6 [18] -> V4: (2 pb, 1 aum) x6 [24] -> V5: (3 pb, 1 aum) x6 [30] -> V6: (4 pb, 1 aum) x6 [36] -> V7: (5 pb, 1 aum) x6 [42].

V8–V15: 42 pb rectas (8 vueltas) [42]. Colocar ojos de 10 mm entre V10 y V11 a 7 ptos de distancia. Bordar pestañas largas, cejas finas, pecas marrón claro y sonrojado acentuado en las mejillas. Rellenar y cerrar.

Melena Corta y Gorro en Espiral:

Cabello Morado: Casquete base en Morado Intenso con melena recta tipo "bob" y flequillo tupido al frente.

Gorro de Açaí en Espiral: En Morado Intenso tejer gorro alto en espiral en BLO formando la cima de remolino (AM 6 pb -> aumentos progresivos hasta 48 pb -> V9–V18: 48 pb acanaladas). Tejer dobladillo crema en FLO y coser ramillete de 3 arándanos con hojas verdes en un costado.

--

3. TAZÓN DE AÇAÍ CON FRUTAS (Ganchillo 2.0 mm)
Cuenco de Mimbre (Marrón/Café):

AM 6 pb -> 12 pb -> 18 pb -> 24 pb -> En BLO V5–V10: 24 pb acanalados formando el bowl.

Crema de Açaí, Plátanos y Frutos Rojos:

Llenar el bowl con crema en Morado Intenso en relieve rematada en espiral. Tejer 6 rodajas de plátano en Amarillo Crema con centro bordado, arándanos azules y frambuesas/moras rojas. Acomodar bordeando la crema.

Ensamblaje Final:

Fijar la cabeza de la niñita al torso del vestido morado.

Colocar la peluca morada y el gorro en espiral de açaí sobre su cabeza.

Posicionar el tazón de açaí lleno de frutas entre sus manos contra su vestido.

⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

Looking for a sweet, fruity, irresistible project filled with cozy charm? 🫐🍌🥣 Craft this stunning Açaí Bowl Girl with Blueberries & Bananas wearing a spiral swirl hat in purple/açaí tone with blueberry and leaf details on the side, short purple bob hair with bangs, a gown with an embroidered fruit apron, purple shoes with double folded socks, holding a bowl filled with açaí cream, banana slices, and berries, and fall in love with every handmade detail!

PROFESSIONAL PATTERN: AÇAÍ BOWL GIRL AMIGURUMI / AÇAÍ BOWL GIRL PATTERN

Project Details:

Final Size: Approx. 22–24 cm tall

Skill Level: Intermediate – Advanced

Key Materials:

Sport/DK Cotton yarn (Light Rosy Peach skin tone, Deep Purple/Açaí for hat, bob hair, and gown, Off-White/Cream for apron, trims, and socks, Blueberry Blue and Leaf Green for fruit details, Cream Yellow for banana slices, Brown/Coffee for wicker bowl)

2.5 mm and 2.0 mm crochet hooks

10 mm black safety eyes

Polyester stuffing, tapestry needle, and scissors

Pronounced pink blush for cheeks and light brown freckles

ABBREVIATIONS (US Terms):
MR = Magic Ring | sc = Single Crochet | inc = Increase | dec = Decrease
ch = Chain | sl st = Slip Stitch | hdc = Half Double Crochet | dc = Double Crochet
BLO = Back Loops Only | FLO = Front Loops Only | [ ] = Total stitches

FULL STEP-BY-STEP PATTERN:
1. PURPLE SHOES, SOCKS & AÇAÍ DRESS (2.5 mm Hook)
Blueberry Shoes & Legs (Make 2):

In Deep Purple: R1: 6 sc in MR [6] -> R2: 6 inc [12] -> R3–R5: 12 sc -> R6: 3 sc, 3 dec, 3 sc [9] (rounded shoes with embroidered blueberry and leaf on tip).

Switch to Off-White (Folded socks): In BLO R7–R11: 9 sc [9] with scalloped edge.

Switch to Light Peach: In BLO R12–R20: 9 sc [9]. Stuff firmly and join legs with ch 3.

Torso, Purple Dress & Embroidered Apron:

Dress: R21–R28: 24 sc in Deep Purple with puffed sleeves in FLO.

Scalloped Apron (Off-White): Attach Off-White in FLO at waist:

Work ribbed apron in FLO with scalloped shell hem (1 sl st, 3 hdc in same st, 1 sl st). Embroider purple blueberry clusters with green leaves scattered across apron.

Arms & Hands (Make 2):

In Light Peach (Hands): MR 6 sc -> R2–R4: 6 sc -> R5–R14: 8 sc with purple puffed cuffs. Sew both hands holding açaí bowl against chest.

--

2. HEAD, PURPLE BANGS & SPIRAL HAT (2.5 mm Hook)
Head (Light Peach Skin):

R1: 6 sc in MR [6] -> R2: 6 inc [12] -> R3: (1 sc, 1 inc) x6 [18] -> R4: (2 sc, 1 inc) x6 [24] -> R5: (3 sc, 1 inc) x6 [30] -> R6: (4 sc, 1 inc) x6 [36] -> R7: (5 sc, 1 inc) x6 [42].

R8–R15: 42 sc straight (8 rounds) [42]. Place 10 mm eyes between R10 and R11, 7 sts apart. Embroider long lashes, fine brows, light brown freckles, and pronounced rosy blush on cheeks. Stuff and close.

Short Bob Hair & Spiral Swirl Hat:

Purple Hair: Base wig cap in Deep Purple with straight bob hair and full front bangs.

Açaí Swirl Hat: In Deep Purple work tall spiral hat in BLO forming swirl peak (MR 6 sc -> progressive increases to 48 sc -> R9–R18: 48 ribbed sc). Work cream brim in FLO and sew cluster of 3 blueberries with green leaves on one side.

--

3. AÇAÍ BOWL WITH FRUIT (2.0 mm Hook)
Wicker Bowl (Brown/Coffee):

MR 6 sc -> 12 sc -> 18 sc -> 24 sc -> In BLO R5–R10: 24 ribbed sc forming bowl.

Açaí Cream, Bananas & Berries:

Fill bowl with Deep Purple cream topped in swirl. Work 6 banana slices in Cream Yellow with embroidered centers, blueberry spheres, and red raspberries/blackberries. Arrange surrounding cream.

Final Assembly:

Attach girl's head to purple dress torso.

Position purple bob wig and spiral açaí hat on head.

Place fruit-filled açaí bowl between her hands against her dress.

💬 ¡Vota con un emoji / Vote with an emoji!
¿Qué otra dulce ilustración frutal o recolectora tejemos a continuación? / Which other sweet fruity illustration or foraging girl scene should we craft next?

🫐 Açaí Bowl Girl with Blueberries & Bananas (Niñita del bowl de açaí)
🍓 Strawberry Shortcake Girl with Cream Crown (Niñita de frutilla con corona de crema)
🍋 Lemonade Cottagecore Girl with Citrus Basket (Niñita de las limonadas con canasta de cítricos)

¡Los leo en los comentarios! / Let me know below! 👇🫐🍌🥣✨

1. PURPLE SHOES, SOCKS & AÇAÍ DRESS (2.5 mm Hook)
Blueberry Shoes & Legs (Make 2):

In Deep Purple: R1: 6 sc in MR [6] -> R2: 6 inc [12] -> R3–R5: 12 sc -> R6: 3 sc, 3 dec, 3 sc [9] (rounded shoes with embroidered blueberry and leaf on tip).

Switch to Off-White (Folded socks): In BLO R7–R11: 9 sc [9] with scalloped edge.

Switch to Light Peach: In BLO R12–R20: 9 sc [9]. Stuff firmly and join legs with ch 3.

Torso, Purple Dress & Embroidered Apron:

Dress: R21–R28: 24 sc in Deep Purple with puffed sleeves in FLO.

Scalloped Apron (Off-White): Attach Off-White in FLO at waist:

Work ribbed apron in FLO with scalloped shell hem (1 sl st, 3 hdc in same st, 1 sl st). Embroider purple blueberry clusters with green leaves scattered across apron.

Arms & Hands (Make 2):

In Light Peach (Hands): MR 6 sc -> R2–R4: 6 sc -> R5–R14: 8 sc with purple puffed cuffs. Sew both hands holding açaí bowl against chest.

--

2. HEAD, PURPLE BANGS & SPIRAL HAT (2.5 mm Hook)
Head (Light Peach Skin):

R1: 6 sc in MR [6] -> R2: 6 inc [12] -> R3: (1 sc, 1 inc) x6 [18] -> R4: (2 sc, 1 inc) x6 [24] -> R5: (3 sc, 1 inc) x6 [30] -> R6: (4 sc, 1 inc) x6 [36] -> R7: (5 sc, 1 inc) x6 [42].

R8–R15: 42 sc straight (8 rounds) [42]. Place 10 mm eyes between R10 and R11, 7 sts apart. Embroider long lashes, fine brows, light brown freckles, and pronounced rosy blush on cheeks. Stuff and close.

Short Bob Hair & Spiral Swirl Hat:

Purple Hair: Base wig cap in Deep Purple with straight bob hair and full front bangs.

Açaí Swirl Hat: In Deep Purple work tall spiral hat in BLO forming swirl peak (MR 6 sc -> progressive increases to 48 sc -> R9–R18: 48 ribbed sc). Work cream brim in FLO and sew cluster of 3 blueberries with green leaves on one side.

--

3. AÇAÍ BOWL WITH FRUIT (2.0 mm Hook)
Wicker Bowl (Brown/Coffee):

MR 6 sc -> 12 sc -> 18 sc -> 24 sc -> In BLO R5–R10: 24 ribbed sc forming bowl.

Açaí Cream, Bananas & Berries:

Fill bowl with Deep Purple cream topped in swirl. Work 6 banana slices in Cream Yellow with embroidered centers, blueberry spheres, and red raspberries/blackberries. Arrange surrounding cream.

Final Assembly:

Attach girl's head to purple dress torso.

Position purple bob wig and spiral açaí hat on head.

Place fruit-filled açaí bowl between her hands against her dress.

¿Qué otra dulce ilustración frutal o recolectora tejemos a continuación? / Which other sweet fruity illustration or foraging girl scene should we craft next?

You guys gave me SO many mixed opinions about the Pink Lemonade 7UP 😂🩷 Some of you LOVE it, others said it’s horrible… so obviously I had to try it with you!

It’s not bad… but I don’t think it’s something I’d buy again. 😅

Have you tried it? What’s your verdict? 👀
